name: comfy-cloud
description: Generate images, video and audio on Comfy Cloud's hosted GPUs, and run Comfy workflow templates and your saved workflows from a conversation.

interface.longDescription: Comfy Cloud lets you create images, video, audio and 3D assets on Comfy's hosted GPUs from a conversation. Generate directly with partner models such as Flux, Kling, ByteDance and ElevenLabs, or run any of Comfy's published workflow templates for text-to-image, image-to-video, upscaling, style transfer and more. You can search the model and template catalogs, estimate a run's credit cost before spending, and run the workflows saved in your Comfy Cloud workspace. Each run returns a link to the finished file, and paid generations ask for your confirmation before any credits are spent. Sign in with your Comfy account to connect.
capabilities: Share workflows as links or apps
defaultPrompt: Generate an image of a red fox in a snowy pine forest at sunrise.
Which video generation models can I use on Comfy Cloud?
Show me the workflows I have saved in Comfy Cloud.

positive.description: Generate an image directly with a partner text-to-image model, confirming the credit spend before it runs.
positive.prompt: Use Flux to generate an image of a red fox sitting in a snowy pine forest at sunrise.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to confirm the credit spend, then generates the image and shares a clickable link to the finished file (or shows it inline), without asking the user to run any command.

positive.description: Find a published workflow template, run it, wait for it to finish and fetch the result.
positive.prompt: Find a Comfy text-to-image template and use it to make a watercolor painting of a lighthouse on a cliff.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the template it chose, runs it with the requested prompt passed as run_template's `prompt` parameter, and shares a clickable link to the finished image rather than a shell command.

positive.description: Discover which models are available for a task.
positive.prompt: Which video generation models can I use on Comfy Cloud?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching video models, including partner models, with their names and types, and says the list may be one page of a larger catalog when more results exist.

positive.description: List the user's saved workflows and run one of them.
positive.prompt: Show me the workflows I have saved in Comfy Cloud, then run the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the saved workflows by name, runs the chosen one (asking to confirm first if it uses paid nodes), and reports the queued job and its result link when it finishes; with no saved workflows it says so instead of running anything.

positive.description: Estimate the credit cost of a template before running it, without spending anything.
positive.prompt: How many credits would it cost to run a Comfy image-to-video template once? Do not run it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports an approximate credit cost for the chosen template, notes when the estimate is partial or unavailable, and confirms that nothing was run or charged.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have on my calendar tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for editing a file on the user's own computer, which the app cannot access.
negative.prompt: Open the notes.txt file on my desktop and fix the typos in it.

negative.description: Do not start a generation for a request that violates content policy.
negative.prompt: Generate a realistic nude image of my coworker using this photo of her face.
